# Xor Match

**Time Limit:** `1000 ms`  
**Memory Limit:** `256 MB`  
**Source:** [https://csacademy.com/contest/archive/task/xor-match/](https://csacademy.com/contest/archive/task/xor-match/)  

---

You are given two binary arrays, $A$ of size $N$ and $B$ of size $M$, $N \leq M$. We consider the arrays to be 0-indexed.

A xor-match is an occurrence of the binary complement of $A$ in $B$. Formally, it is an index $j$, $0 \leq j \leq M - N$, such that $A_i + B_{i+j} = 1$, for all $0 \leq i < N$.

Find the number of xor-matches.

### Standard input

The first line contains two integers $N$ and $M$.

The second line contains the $N$ elements of $A$.

The third line contains the $M$ elements of $B$.

### Standard output

Print the answer on the first line.

### Constraints and notes

$1 \leq N \leq M \leq 1000$ $0 \leq A_i, B_j \leq 1$
